messages:
mira: Hey — first week Qs on benefits/payroll for my Ireland hire status. I see I was invited to the People Ops portal but not sure when medical/dental actually starts and whether my spouse coverage will be active right away. Also: will my relocation reimbursement hit first paycheck or separate?

lina: welcome, mira! :wave: quick answers — since you're on the Ireland payroll (EOR), standard benefits enrollment kicks in at the start of the next calendar month after your hire date. so if your start was 3/15, benefits begin 4/1. spouse/dependent coverage needs proof (marriage cert or civil partnership + proof of address).

mira: ok makes sense. where do I upload the dependent docs? I tried the portal upload but it failed with a 400.

hr-bot: Lina assigned you: "Dependent verification" — please upload docs via the People Ops portal > Benefits > Dependents. Accepted formats: pdf/jpg/png. Max 10MB.

lina: if the portal throws 400 again, try incognito or attach here (we can move to secure intake). also include the dependent's full name and DOB in the upload filename so we can match.

mira: thanks — will try incognito now. one more thing: relocation reimbursement — I submitted receipts last week under Expense > Relocation. timeline?

jen-payroll: hey mira — reimbursements are processed on a separate payroll run (not regular salary). typical timeline is 2 payroll cycles from approval. if your receipts were approved today, expect it in the next 2 runs. i'll DM you if anything looks off.

mira: awesome, ty. last tiny Q: tax withholding — will there be any PAYE setup I need to do here or is that handled automatically by EOR?

jen-payroll: EOR handles PAYE registration and withholding for Ireland. you may get a local tax form to confirm allowances — we'll route that through the portal. if you don't see it in 3 business days, ping me and i'll escalate.

lina: also FYI: commuter/wellness stipend for EMEA is handled quarterly; it won't show up until the next quarter payout after benefits effective date.

mira: super helpful, thank you both. i'll re-upload in incognito and post here if it fails. :thumbsup:

lina: perfect — tag me if upload fails and we'll collect securely. welcome again! :tada:
